question: how many days off do i get?
answer:

1.2 Sick Leave
Employees have 10 sick leave days per year for personal illness or medical appointments. Sick leave does not accrue and unused days do not carry over. For absences exceeding 3 consecutive days, a medical certificate must be provided. The company reserves the right to request medical documentation for any sick leave taken. Extended Medical Leave: 11-30 days: Requires medical certification and HR approval 31+ days: May qualify for short-term disability benefits Chronic conditions: Accommodations available under ADA compliance 1.3 Maternity/Paternity Leave
Maternity Leave: Female employees are entitled to 14 weeks of paid maternity leave 6 weeks pre-delivery and 8 weeks post-delivery (flexible based on medical advice) Additional 4 weeks unpaid leave available with manager approval Adoption leave: 10 weeks for primary adopting parent Paternity Leave: Male employees are entitled to 5 days of paid paternity leave Additional 2 weeks of unpaid leave available

Human Resources Policy Manual (Comprehensive Edition)
Section 1: Leave Policies
1.1 Annual Leave
Employees are entitled to 21 annual leave days per calendar year. Annual leave accrues at a rate of 1.75 days per month of service. Leave requests must be submitted at least two weeks in advance through the HR portal. Emergency leave requests will be considered on a case-by-case basis with proper documentation. Accrual Details: 0-2 years of service: 21 days annually 3-5 years of service: 25 days annually 6-10 years of service: 30 days annually 10+ years of service: 35 days annually Unused annual leave may be carried over to the next year, up to a maximum of 15 days. Any leave beyond this limit will be forfeited unless special approval is obtained from senior management. Employees may request to cash out up to 5 days of unused annual leave each year during the designated enrollment period.
